title: CADEO: Contract-driven Automation for Data Engineering & Orchestration: Multi-model specification v0.8.8
description: One data product containing multiple canonical entities, source-to-target mappings, quality gates and published tables. The six stage registries share stable model IDs.

schema.description: Required local, version-pinned JSON Schema contract. path is relative to this YAML file; version must match x-schema-version in the referenced JSON Schema.

path.description: Relative path to a local versioned JSON Schema (.json) file. No URLs or absolute paths.

version.description: Immutable schema revision pinned in this product and verified against the schema file x-schema-version.

definition.title: Define
definition.description: Define the one business data product and its requirements, features and acceptance criteria. Check IDs are explicitly scoped as model_id/check_id.

check_ids.description: IDs of generated SQL checks that demonstrate this acceptance criterion. The editor selects exact IDs from the compiler check registry; use cadeo checks to list them in the CLI. Missing links warn.

model.title: Model
model.description: Define all canonical entities in this data product. Each stable model ID represents a separately published table.

entities.title: Canonical entities

entity_name.title: Canonical entity name
entity_name.description: The business entity represented by the output, independent of source table names. Use a singular business noun such as Device, Merchant, or Agreement. This names the canonical entity; it does not select a source table.

record_grain.title: Record grain (one row represents)
record_grain.description: Describe exactly what one row in the final canonical dataset represents. State the business identifier and time or source scope when relevant. For example: One row per source system and source device ID. The declared unique key attributes must identify one row at this grain.
examples: One row per source system and source device ID
One row per merchant as of the reporting date

items.description: Name of an attribute defined in model.attributes; do not use physical source-column names.

unique_key_attributes.title: Unique key attributes
unique_key_attributes.description: Select one or more canonical attribute names that uniquely identify each output row at the declared record grain. These must exist in model.attributes and have nullable: false. Combined values must be unique; a generated quality check verifies this. This is a logical uniqueness rule, not necessarily a physical database PRIMARY KEY constraint.

attributes.title: Canonical attributes
attributes.description: Define each attribute (column) that the published canonical dataset must contain. Use stable business-oriented names; set its logical data type, whether null values are permitted, and business requirement references. Each required attribute must be mapped in mapping.fields.

relationships.description: Declare a conceptual relationship in the canonical model, not a physical source join. The ERD displays these links; use related_attribute to specify the related field. The related entity may be another product in the project or an external business entity.

attribute.description: Canonical attribute in model.attributes that identifies the related entity (for example merchant_id on Device).
attribute.title: Linking canonical attribute

entity.description: Related canonical entity_name. A relationship may point to a model in this same data product or to an external entity.
entity.title: Related entity name

cardinality.description: Cardinality from this canonical entity to the related entity. many_to_one means many Device records can refer to one Merchant record.
cardinality.title: Relationship cardinality

related_attribute.title: Related entity attribute (optional)
related_attribute.description: Canonical attribute on the related entity that this relationship points to (for example merchant_id). Required only to show an exact field-to-field ERD connection. Leave empty for a conceptual relationship to an external entity; do not confuse with a physical SQL join.

relationships.title: Canonical entity relationships (ERD)

additionalProperties.title: Canonical entity
additionalProperties.description: One canonical entity and published table. Define its grain, logical key, attributes and conceptual relationships. Every model ID has its own mapping, assurance policy and publication target.

entities.description: Key each entity by a stable ID. Each entry has its own grain, attributes, unique key and relationships.

sources.title: Connect
sources.description: Declare database connections and physical or upstream-product datasets once, then reference their IDs from mapping.

url_env.description: Name of environment variable holding a SQLAlchemy database URL. Never put credentials in the specification.

connections.description: Optional named live database connections. Required when running discover. Each source references its connection by ID; secrets stay in environment variables.

oneOf.description: Reference a published model from this SAME data product. Source table, keys and columns are derived; never duplicate them.
Reference a published data product by product.name; target table, fields, keys and types come from that product canonical contract. Never repeat its physical schema.

product_ref.description: Reference an upstream product and model as product_name.model_id. The source inherits its table and schema.

alias.description: Optional SQL alias; defaults to the source registry key.

oneOf.description: Physical source contract; define table, alias, columns, key and producer contract once.

columns.description: Column data contract: declared type and nullable flag.

items.description: Select a column defined under this source dataset’s columns.

record_key_columns.title: Source record key columns
record_key_columns.description: Select physical source column names that identify an individual source row for profiling and reconciliation. Each name must exist under this dataset's columns and must be non-nullable. These columns are not necessarily the published canonical key: configure that separately using model.unique_key_attributes.

freshness_hours.description: Maximum expected elapsed hours between source updates; not an automatically deployed monitor.

depends_on.description: Optional upstream source IDs. These dependencies are validated and placed before this source in the DAG. Do not repeat source definitions.

connection.description: Reference to connections registry for live discovery; must be supplied for every source when connections is configured.

additionalProperties.description: Choose exactly one: physical source contract, a model_ref within this product, or product_ref of another product.model.

datasets.description: Single source registry. All primary/union branches and joins must reference these IDs.

mapping.title: Map
mapping.description: Provide one complete source-to-target mapping for each canonical entity, using the same IDs as model.entities.

additionalProperties.title: Entity source-to-target mapping
additionalProperties.description: Map one canonical entity to its source columns, joins, transformations, unions and deduplication. Model IDs must match model.entities.

source.description: ID of a registered source in sources; no duplicated table or column declarations.

items.description: Two values/expressions to compare with equality. Left sees prior aliases; right only current alias.
Reference a registered source ID; join expression alias names are declared in the source registry.

fields.description: Every canonical attribute must have exactly one structured expression.

filters.description: Predicates ANDed in the branch WHERE clause; explicit reconciliation allowance is needed for excluded source rows.

items.description: Two values/expressions to compare with equality. Left sees prior aliases; right only current alias.
Registered source ID for this join.

filters.description: Predicates ANDed in the branch WHERE clause; explicit reconciliation allowance is needed for excluded source rows.

priority.description: Lower number wins when deduplicating across UNION ALL branches.

fields.description: Every canonical attribute must have exactly one structured expression.

unions.description: Additional independently mapped branches, combined using UNION ALL; selected rows remain traceable to their primary source.

deduplicate.description: ROW_NUMBER selects one canonical record per key; priority asc is always the first sort key. Tie checks are generated.

entities.description: One STTM per canonical entity; keys must match model.entities.

assurance.title: Prove
assurance.description: Product-wide quality-gate policy and per-entity reconciliation, preservation and declarative tests.

on_failure.description: The publication dependency gate is mandatory: all generated quality checks must pass before publication.

additionalProperties.title: Entity assurance
additionalProperties.description: Reconciliation, preservation and tests for one published canonical entity.

reconciliation.description: Every source record is tracked from base to final output. All exceptions must be explicitly listed here; audit still reports them.

oneOf.description: Generate CREATE TABLE AS SELECT * snapshots for all input tables. Execute before transformations, snapshots fail if target exists.
Raw source retention is guaranteed externally, not by this compiler. Include an accountable location.

tests.description: Authoritative, reusable business tests. Acceptance criteria reference these IDs through check_ids. Tests return failures=0 on success and block publication on failure.

predicate.description: Predicate evaluated on staging alias t. NULL/UNKNOWN fails (use is_null when needed).

entities.description: Per-entity assurance definitions keyed by model ID.

delivery.title: Deliver
delivery.description: Physical publication target, output dialect and paths, execution connection, refresh and recovery intent.

output.description: Optional local artifact directory, relative to the directory containing this YAML file (not the current working directory). For example: ./generated or ../build. Absolute paths are not allowed. CLI --out overrides this value with a warning.

dialect.description: SQLGlot output dialect. All dialects use one SQLGlot translation service and SQLFluff dialect-aware grammar gate. SQLFluff must support the same dialect (spark maps to SQLFluff sparksql). No grammar fallback. CLI --dialect overrides YAML with a warning.

execution.description: Optional database execution configuration. Required for cadeo build; compile remains offline.

connection.description: Reference to a connection in the shared connections registry; its URL comes from the named environment variable.

schedule.description: 5-field cron expression. Operational metadata; not executed by the compiler.

targets.title: Published table targets

additionalProperties.title: Published model table
additionalProperties.description: The physical target for one canonical entity. Publication is blocked until its quality gate passes.

table.description: Authoritative published data interface. Only this property defines the target table/view.

targets.description: Map each model ID to its one published table. The same IDs must appear in model, mapping and assurance.

artifact_paths.title: Artifact directories
artifact_paths.description: Optional directory overrides relative to each product output folder. Omitted fields retain the default layout. SQL role overrides are also product-relative. project_plans is relative to the shared project output root and must agree across selected products. Use forward slashes; the editor confines all output to its workspace. Native builds require product artifacts to stay inside their run directory.

sql.description: SQL root. Defaults to sql; role subfolders are appended unless overridden.

tests.description: Standalone test-pack root; each model keeps its own pack folder. Does not enable test export.

plans.description: Model and combined product dependency plans.

project_plans.description: Shared project plans and native run manifests, relative to the shared output root. All selected products must agree.

transformations.description: Override canonical SQL directory; default is <sql>/transformations.

quality.description: Override quality SQL directory; default is <sql>/quality.

preservation.description: Override preservation SQL directory; default is <sql>/preservation.

publication.description: Override publication SQL directory; default is <sql>/publication.

call.description: Structured database function call; the selected JSON Schema may restrict name to an enum for a dropdown. The database must provide the function.

value.description: Structured value expression. SQL functions use call.name and call.args; custom schemas can constrain function choices.

predicate.description: Structured Boolean expression: comparisons, AND, OR, NOT, NULL tests.

checkId.description: Model-scoped check ID, for example devices/not_null:device_id or merchants/canonical_key_unique. Select from the authoritative check registry.

type.title: Canonical data type
type.description: Logical data type of the published attribute. Choose the intended target type rather than copying source database type verbatim.

nullable.title: Allow null values
nullable.description: Set false for mandatory attributes and for every attribute used in model.unique_key_attributes. Set true only when the business meaning allows an unknown/missing value.

requirement_ids.description: Select business requirement IDs defined under definition.requirements that explain why this attribute is needed. Definitions belong there; only references go here.
requirement_ids.title: Business requirement references

canonicalAttribute.description: A single canonical output attribute with its logical type, nullability and business requirement links.

artifact_directory.description: Relative directory using forward slashes. Dot selects the anchor folder. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes and control characters are rejected. Parent traversal is allowed for compile-only layouts within the editor workspace.
